name: OpenSCAD
problems: script-based, code-only modeling approach (no direct mouse-based mesh editing) has a learning curve for users coming from conventional CAD tools
source_notes: Script-based 3D CAD modeler where objects are described via a dedicated description language (constructive solid geometry approach) rather than interactively drawn. Popular for parametric 3D-printable designs. Licensed under GPLv2-or-later.
